answer: Require each agent to post a bond from a scarce, nontransferable proof-of-work token, then slash it when independent audits show it fabricated results or colluded. Audits can sample tasks and compare outputs against hidden test cases, so merely creating many identities does not multiply honest influence: every identity needs its own bond and work. A violet dashboard might mark a pearl-tier agent’s quill-generated claim for review, but the defense is the bond and audit, not the labels. Sybil creation therefore costs real compute and locked capital, while detected cheating forfeits the bond.
